about.text1: Each of the 12 scenarios adds weighted points toward seven archetypal K-POP positions: Vocal, Leader, Rapper, Dancer, Visual, Maknae, and All-Rounder.
about.tieRule: Ties are resolved deterministically using an answer sequence hash to avoid favoring early options.
about.text2: Real K-POP group dynamics evolve across generations. This game is an entertaining reflection designed to celebrate group teamwork and individuality.

guide.guideHeading: The Five Core Role Pillars in Modern K-Pop
guide.vocalRoleDesc: Responsible for melody delivery, high-note peaks, and vocal stability in live stages. Main Vocals anchor challenging climaxes, while Lead Vocals guide verses and transitions.
guide.danceRoleDesc: Defines the sharpness of group synchronization and commands dance breaks. Main Dancers bring technical prowess and rhythm leadership to visually anchor the stage.
guide.rapRoleDesc: Shapes rhythmic pace and dynamic transitions with distinctive flow, attitude, and diction, infusing tracks with genre authenticity.
guide.leaderCenterDesc: The Leader fosters team unity, media presence, and emotional support, while the Center visually symbolizes the core concept during key choruses.
guide.allRounderDesc: A multi-faceted talent capable of singing, rapping, dancing, and commanding center stage without weakness—increasingly standard in 4th/5th generation groups.

faq.q1: Are K-pop idol positions official across all groups?
faq.a1: While 2nd and 3rd generation groups traditionally defined clear Main and Lead titles, many 4th and 5th generation groups favor fluid, all-rounder structures without fixed positions.
faq.q2: What is the difference between 'Main' and 'Lead' roles?
faq.a2: In K-pop terminology, 'Main' roles handle the most demanding technical moments (high notes, dance breaks), while 'Lead' roles guide song verses and support the melody.
faq.q3: How does this test calculate my position?
faq.a3: It assesses 12 everyday and performance scenarios (karaoke, project leadership, stress release, aesthetic taste) to match your strengths with one of seven archetypes.
faq.q4: What does 'All-Rounder' or 'Ace' mean in K-pop?
faq.a4: An All-Rounder possesses high-level proficiency across vocals, dance, rap, and stage presence, allowing seamless transitions into any role.
faq.q5: Does this quiz assess actual audition readiness or singing talent?
faq.a5: No. This is an entertaining personality reflection created for fun and self-discovery. It is not an audition rating or talent test.
